title: Managed Backup: ingestion
content:

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, incremental ingestion rate is 0.009.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, incremental ingestion rate stays the same.
